## Type of change

- [ ] Feat — new feature
- [ ] Fix — bug fix
- [ ] Refactor — no behavior change
- [ ] Chore — deps, tooling, housekeeping
- [ ] Docs — documentation
- [ ] Test — tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch named `feat/`, `fix/`, `refactor/`, `chore/`, `docs/`, or `test/`
- [ ] `deno task verify` passes (fmt + lint + check + test)
- [ ] `deno task build` passes
- [ ] No new `Reciever*` names introduced (use `Receiver*`)
- [ ] No Node/`package.json`/Yarn tooling reintroduced
- [ ] New logic includes tests next to the code (`*.test.ts`)
